automation_rule: Hourly automation updates JSON data only and never rewrites HTML/JS/CSS/VERSION.

deployment.android: Capacitor generates Android, syncs committed public/, branding script writes icon + MainActivity native Back fallback, then Gradle builds APK.

v033_root_cause: User screenshot showed Market Radar v0.3.0 safe shell although repository was already v0.3.2; treat any older version shown to the user as stale deployed/cached content, not a successful release.
Legacy service worker cached reports/latest.html and old assets. v0.3.3 replaces sw.js with a cache-killer that deletes every origin cache and unregisters itself.
public/index.html also unregisters every service worker, clears every CacheStorage entry and removes old mr:last-good caches before redirecting with a fresh query string.
public/reports/latest.html now boots v0.3.3 assets sequentially with a timestamp on every script URL, then app-runtime-v33 verifies the complete dashboard.
app-runtime-v33 allows at most one recovery reload and marks an incomplete screen as an error instead of pretending it is normal.
android_back_contract: If a detail/modal/popup is open, hardware Back closes it and consumes the event.
At the root screen, hardware Back shows 앱을 종료하시겠습니까? with 취소/종료.
Native MainActivity fallback is mandatory in APK builds.
qa: The first visible version label must match VERSION. Showing v0.3.0/v0.3.1/v0.3.2 after v0.3.3 is released is a failure.
Full dashboard renders beyond Hero/action only; at least 8 major sections exist and page height exceeds two viewports.
loadState must end at 정상 · v0.3.3 전체 대시보드 로드 완료 for a successful render.
No stale last-good partial screen is restored.
Hardware Back closes a visible detail modal.
Hardware Back at root shows native exit confirmation.
No browser-default white buttons, no overlap, no horizontal drift, large charts preserved.
